query:
INSERT INTO users (sub, login, email, last_login, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $4, $4)
         ON CONFLICT (sub) DO UPDATE
            SET login = EXCLUDED.login,
                email = EXCLUDED.email,
                last_login = EXCLUDED.last_login,
                updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
